components.name: Action Amber Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action on the quiet neutral workbench.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFC844; color: #201B12; font: 700 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 10px rgba(79,85,76,.28); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #F2B91F; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); background: #DFA90A; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005B66; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Amber Recessed Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #202722; font: 700 13px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #D7DDD8; color: #202722; box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 8px #EEF2EF, inset 4px 4px 8px #AAB5AC; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #45544A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005B66; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Neumorphic Theme Option
components.css: .ds-theme { min-height: 72px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #D7DDD8; color: #202722; box-shadow: -4px -4px 8px #EEF2EF, 4px 4px 8px #AAB5AC; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 700 13px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-theme:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #005B66; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFC844; }

components.name: Neo-Brutal Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt action with black structure and physical press feedback.
components.css: .ds-brutal-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 3px solid #171717; border-radius: 4px; background: #315EFB; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #171717; font: 900 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-brutal-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px,-2px); background: #2449CC; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #171717; } .ds-brutal-primary:active { transform: translate(3px,3px); background: #1939A6; box-shadow: none; } .ds-brutal-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #171717; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Smart Search keeps one information architecture across cyber-dark, amber-neumorphic, and neo-brutalism. The brutal theme uses concrete gray, heavy black structure, cobalt actions, compact coral emphasis, and no decorative patterns or blur.
keyCharacteristics: Amber or cobalt reserved for primary actions

rules.name: The No-Leak Rule
rules.body: Theme-specific accent colors never appear in the other theme unless they encode real external content.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Plain information rows stay flat; if everything casts a shadow, the hierarchy has failed.

dos: Preserve the default cyber-dark theme's current computed colors and layout.
Use only zero-blur hard shadows in neo-brutalism.
Maintain visible focus, 320px reflow, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Create a toy-like soft-plastic interface in amber-neumorphic.
Use saturated yellow as a page or card background.
Add dots, stripes, gradients, glass, or blurred shadows to neo-brutalism.
